name: fab
summary: A floating action button that fans out a staggered speed dial as its plus turns to ×.
props: Speed-dial items, bottom → top (arc: first → last). icon can be a node or ({ color }) => node; with color the icon colour contrasts automatically. Omit for a plain FAB.
Called when there are no actions.
Main icon (rotates 135° when open). A function is re-coloured as the button turns neutral when open.
Makes it an extended FAB (icon + label).
Set false (e.g. while scrolling) to collapse the label into a circle.
Speed dial starts open when uncontrolled.
Labelled column, or mini buttons fanned out on a quarter circle (half circle for bottom-center). Arc hides the chips; labels stay as accessibility labels.
Corner of the parent it sits in.
accent: solid fill + same-colour glow; gradient: opt-in two-tone; tonal: soft tinted surface; primary / secondary: theme surfaces.
Tint for accent, gradient and tonal; glow, foreground (and the opt-in gradient stops) are derived from it.
Dim the parent while open; tap to close.
Looping attention ring (skipped with Reduce Motion), e.g. for empty-state calls to action.
Rotate the icon into × when open.
Style for the absolutely positioned stack holding the main button and list actions.
behavior: Tapping the button opens the speed dial over an optional dimmed backdrop; tapping the backdrop closes it. Without actions it just calls onPress.
Actions spring out one after another as a labelled list or an arc. An extended FAB springs between a pill and a circle, and pulse loops a ring around it.
The pulse ring stays off when reduce motion is on.
A light impact when the button opens or closes the dial, or fires onPress.
The main button and each action are buttons; the main button reads "Open actions" / "Close actions" with an expanded state when it has a dial.
